turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, is that Emily? It's Oliver calling from Acme Life Cover. You filled in a form on our website asking for a call back about life cover.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Oh, yes, hello. I did, after I saw your advert in the paper last week. I wasn't sure anyone would actually ring.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Well, here I am! I've got your form in front of me. It says you're sixty-six, living in Leicester, non-smoker, and you were interested in somewhere around twenty-five to thirty thousand pounds of cover. Is now still a good time?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yes, that's fine. I've just made a cup of tea, so go ahead.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Lovely. Before I talk about any quotes, can I ask a bit about you and what's made you think about cover? It helps me work out whether this is even the right thing for you.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Of course. I retired from teaching in July, primary school, thirty-odd years. My husband passed away a few years ago, and I've got three grandchildren now. I'd just like to leave them a little something, you know, towards university or a first car or whatever they need.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's a lovely reason. Do you have any other life cover at the moment, maybe through work or an old policy?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: There was something through the teachers' scheme, but I think that's stopped now I've retired. I've got my pension and a bit of savings, but I don't really want to touch the savings, they're for me if I need care later on.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That makes sense. And is there a mortgage or any debts you'd want the cover to pay off, or is it really just a gift for the grandchildren?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: No mortgage, thank goodness. It's just for the grandchildren.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Right. And budget-wise, have you got a figure in mind for what you'd be comfortable paying each month?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: I don't want anything too much. Maybe fifteen, twenty pounds at the very most. I'm on a fixed income now.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. So, based on what you've told me, the Acme Life Cover plan could suit you. You can choose cover anywhere from twenty-five thousand up to five hundred thousand pounds, but given your budget and what you want it for, the lower end sounds about right. From your form details, I've got a quote here of fifteen pounds a month for twenty-five thousand pounds of cover.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Fifteen pounds. That's within what I said. But at my age, don't you need a medical? I really don't fancy being poked and prodded.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No medical exam at all. Instead there are a few health questions, and whether you're accepted depends on your answers to those. So I can't promise acceptance until we've gone through them, but there's no doctor's visit.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Right. And does the price go up as I get older? That happened with my car insurance every year.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No, the premium is fixed for the whole length of the policy. If it starts at fifteen pounds a month, it stays at fifteen pounds a month.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: That's reassuring. Is there a catch, though? There's always a catch.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: There's one important thing you need to know. In the first twelve months, only accidental death is covered. So if you died from an illness during that first year, the policy wouldn't pay out. After twelve months, you're covered in full.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Hmm. So if I had a heart attack in the first year, the grandchildren wouldn't get anything?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's right, not in the first twelve months, because that wouldn't count as accidental. It's worth thinking about whether that's acceptable to you.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: I suppose I'm in reasonable health. I walk most days. I'm just a bit wary, I've never bought anything like this over the phone.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's completely fair. There's no rush at all. If you'd rather think it over, talk to your family, I can send you the details and you can come back to us whenever you're ready. The price won't disappear tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: What happens if I sign up and then change my mind?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: There's a thirty-day cooling-off period. If you cancel within thirty days, you get a full refund of anything you've paid.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Well, that makes me feel better. Go on then, let's do the health questions and see.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Of course. Have you been diagnosed with, or are you currently being treated for, any heart condition, cancer, stroke or diabetes?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: No, none of those. I take a tablet for my blood pressure, but it's well controlled.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. Mild, controlled blood pressure is fine for this plan. And in the last five years, have you been admitted to hospital overnight or been told you need further tests you're waiting on?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: No. Just my cataract done two years ago, and that was a day case.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's fine. Based on those answers, you're accepted at the quoted price.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Oh, good.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: So before we go any further, let me just summarise. It's Acme Life Cover, twenty-five thousand pounds of cover, at fifteen pounds a month, and that premium is fixed for the whole policy. In the first twelve months only accidental death is covered, and after that you're fully covered. There's no medical exam, and you've got thirty days to cancel for a full refund. Are you happy to go ahead with that?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yes. Yes, I'd like to go ahead.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Wonderful. I'll send your policy documents and a Direct Debit form out in the post and by email today. Have a good read through, and if anything doesn't look right, just give us a ring.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: I will. Thank you, Oliver, you've been very patient with me.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Not at all, Emily. It's a lovely thing you're doing for the grandchildren. Enjoy your tea, and take care.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: You too. Bye now.
